interactions.title: DDInter drug–drug interactions (download files), mapped to RxNorm ingredients
interactions.version: DDInter download files (DDInter 1.0, 2021; re-served by DDInter 2.0, May 2024)
interactions.source: DDInter, Computational Biology & Drug Design Group (https://ddinter2.scbdd.com/download/): the eight download files, ATC groups A, B, D, H, L, P, R and V. Tian Y, et al. DDInter 2.0. Nucleic Acids Res 2025;53(D1):D1356–D1362; Xiong G, et al. DDInter. Nucleic Acids Res 2022;50:D1200–D1207.
interactions.licence: DDInter data: Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 4.0 International (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0). This file is adapted from DDInter: drug names were mapped to RxNorm ingredients, unmapped names and combination products were left out, and where DDInter lists a drug in several forms the highest risk level is kept. It is shared under the same licence. DDInter states that it cannot guarantee the accuracy or completeness of its contents and that the absence of an interaction does not necessarily mean that no interaction exists. The download files hold no mechanism or management text.
